experiment: standalone LSTM vs 1D-CNN vs Transformer under leave-one-mechanism-out
scope: synthetic data only; no real patient or insurance claim data
purpose: separately train and evaluate each architecture on the same synthetic benchmark
comparison_design: native mode: architecture and input modality vary together

metrics_semantics.known_class_accuracy: multiclass accuracy on test claims from classes seen during training; held-out mechanism excluded from this metric
metrics_semantics.novel_mechanism_auroc: held-out fraud mechanism positive vs every non-held-out test claim, using fused energy/Mahalanobis novelty
metrics_semantics.novel_recall_at_conformal_alpha_005: fraction of held-out mechanism claims rejected by the calibration-set conformal p-value rule at alpha=0.05
metrics_semantics.rare_severe_benign_false_rejection_rate: fraction of rare-severe legitimate test claims rejected by the same novelty gate

split_protocol: same generator seed and stratified train/calibration/test partition across model architectures; hidden mechanism excluded from train, validation and calibration

runs.novelty_method: equal-weight energy empirical-CDF + latent Mahalanobis empirical-CDF; split conformal calibration
runs.train_validation_calibration_protocol: stratified train pool; 15% known-only validation; separate known-only calibration window; untouched held-out test partition

limitations: Synthetic generator contains designed proxies for each mechanism; metrics measure performance on this generator only.
A held-out mechanism is evaluated as novelty; it is not a separately supervised output class.
The three architectures are trained independently, not as the same fused encoder.
Native mode varies input modality; shared_context mode supplies identical standardized context tokens and a padding mask to all three architectures.
Temporal graph encoder and public provider-level benchmark are separate experiments and not combined into this standalone comparison.
Three seeds provide an initial stability check, not publication-grade confidence intervals; complete the registered seed/ablation plan before submission.
